lesson.title: Verb Dynasties: venir, tenir & prendre Matrices
lesson.subtitle: Prefix × root matrices: re-/de-/ob-/main-/com-/ap- across venir, tenir, and prendre.

hook.title: Three Roots, Two Dozen Verbs — The Prefix × Root Matrix
hook.content: Once you know venir ('to come'), tenir ('to hold', which conjugates identically to venir!), and prendre ('to take'), directional prefixes unlock revenir ('come back'), devenir ('become'), obtenir ('obtain/get'), maintenir ('maintain = hold in the hand!'), comprendre ('understand = grasp together'), and apprendre ('learn')!

footnotes.title: Why maintenir is literally 'hand-hold'
footnotes.content: main ('hand') + tenir ('hold') = maintenir ('to maintain')! And every prefixed compound conjugates 100% identically to its root!

pattern.title: Every Compound Conjugates Exactly Like Its Root (-venir, -tenir, -prendre)
pattern.content: venir → je viens / venu; tenir → je tiens / tenu; prendre → je prends / pris.
pattern.linguist_note: Derivational prefixation on Latin venīre, tenēre, and prehendere is shared across French and English.
pattern.trap_note: See the root (-venir, -tenir, -prendre) inside the compound and conjugate it like the base verb!

exercises.prompt: Match each prefixed verb with its literal building blocks and meaning:
exercises.target_answer: to come back / return, to become (come into a state), to obtain / get, to maintain (hold in the hand), to learn (grasp toward oneself)
exercises.meaning: revenir (re- + venir), devenir (de- + venir), obtenir (ob- + tenir), maintenir (main + tenir), apprendre (ap- + prendre)
exercises.explanation: Three roots (venir, tenir, prendre) generate all of these verbs.

exercises.prompt: Complete the Verb Root × Form Matrix for 'comprendre' ('to understand') in the passé composé participle:
exercises.row_law: Each row follows its root family (-venir, -tenir, -prendre).
exercises.column_law: Column 1 is the 1st-person present; Column 2 is the past participle (-u for venir/tenir, -is for prendre).
exercises.explanation: prendre → pris, so comprendre → compris and apprendre → appris!

exercises.prompt: French apprendre ('to learn') gave English which noun for a beginner learning a trade under a master?
exercises.explanation: An apprentice is literally 'someone who is learning' (from Old French aprentiz, built on apprendre).

exercises.idea: I am learning French and I understand now
cues: I learn the French → J'apprends le français + and I understand now → et je comprends maintenant
idea_parts: first verb + object → J'apprends le français
second verb + adverb → et je comprends maintenant
exercises.target_answer: J'apprends le français et je comprends maintenant
exercises.meaning: I am learning French and I understand now
exercises.explanation: Both j'apprends and je comprends follow je prends.

diagnosis.cue: Conjugate j'apprends and je comprends like je prends.

exercises.prompt: Listen and write the whole sentence.
exercises.meaning: I am going to come back tomorrow morning
exercises.affirmation: You heard revenir and demain matin cleanly.

summary.outcome: Decode and conjugate the -venir (revenir, devenir), -tenir (obtenir, maintenir), and -prendre (comprendre, apprendre) verb dynasties.

use_example.german: J'apprends vite et je vais revenir demain.
use_example.english: I learn quickly and I'm going to come back tomorrow.

summary.takeaway: Learn three roots (venir, tenir, prendre) and six prefixes, and two dozen verbs conjugate themselves.
summary.curiosity_teaser: Up next on Le Pont ([29] The French Mind): see how Verb Dynasties: venir, tenir & prendre Matrices leads directly into The French Mind.

twist.prompt: Think it through again without looking back — express "I am learning French and I understand now" in French:
twist.target_answer: J'apprends le français et je comprends maintenant
twist.explanation: Re-constructing "J'apprends le français et je comprends maintenant" from the underlying rule cements the pattern of Verb Dynasties: venir, tenir & prendre Matrices.

venir.etymology_derivation: Prefix it to build a whole family: revenir (come back), devenir (become), prévenir (warn).

revenir.context_translation: I'm going to come back tomorrow.

tenir.etymology_derivation: Conjugates exactly like venir (je tiens, je viens).

maintenir.etymology_derivation: Literally 'to hold in the hand' (main + tenir)!

comprendre.etymology_derivation: To understand is literally 'to grasp together'.

apprendre.etymology_derivation: An apprentice is literally 'one who is learning'.

compris.etymology_derivation: prendre → pris, comprendre → compris, apprendre → appris.

pris.etymology_derivation: French uses prendre ('to take') for ordering food and drink, just like English 'I'll take a coffee'.
